description: Labelled identity pairs for calibrating the correlation model. Profiles are referenced by key into profiles.json, which holds exactly what the project's own adapters observed on a real public page. Every 'same' label cites a connection the account owner published themselves - a Gravatar verified account, a Keybase proof, a website named on a profile - because a label derived from a matching name or photograph would be the signal under test. Pairs marked 'indirect' are the valuable ones: neither profile links to the other, so the model has to recover the connection rather than read it. Negative pairs are chosen deliberately, and the hard ones share a handle, an employer or a community with the party they are not.
